description: This Java source file defines the ModelIndex class, which models the <index> element within the OFBiz framework's entity model. It includes methods for creating index instances, parsing XML representations, and generating XML output. The class handles index attributes like name, uniqueness, description, and fields, and provides inner classes/enums for index fields and functions.

classes.name: ModelIndex
classes.description: Represents an index in the entity model, including properties like name, uniqueness, description, and associated fields. Provides XML serialization and deserialization functionalities.

classes.name: ModelIndex.Field
classes.description: Inner class representing a field within the index, with optional functions like LOWER or UPPER applied to the field.

classes.name: ModelIndex.Function
classes.description: Enum defining available functions (LOWER, UPPER) that can be applied to index fields.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new ModelIndex instance with specified entity, description, name, fields, and uniqueness flag.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new ModelIndex instance from an XML element representing the index.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the index.

methods.name: getUnique
methods.description: Checks if the index enforces a uniqueness constraint.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields included in the index.

methods.name: toXmlElement
methods.description: Serializes the ModelIndex instance into an XML <index> element.

methods.name: Field
methods.description: Represents a specific field within an index, including field name and optional function.
